definitions.explanation: Describes flowers whose blossoms have many overlapping petals, or things arranged in many layers. Contrasted with {一重|ひとえ} (single-petaled, single-layered). Here {八|はち} ("eight") stands for "many."

examples.japanese: この{花|はな}は{八重|やえ}だ。
examples.english: This flower is a double (multi-petaled) variety.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{八重|やえ}の{梅|うめ}が{咲|さ}いた。
examples.english: Double plum blossoms bloomed in the garden.

examples.japanese: {八重|やえ}{咲|ざ}きの{品種|ひんしゅ}は{花|はな}びらが{多|おお}く{豪華|ごうか}に{見|み}える。
examples.english: Double-flowering varieties have many petals and look gorgeous.

notes:
Refers to blossoms with many overlapping petals, contrasted with {一重|ひとえ} (single-petaled). Also means "multi-layered" or "eightfold" more generally, where {八|はち} ("eight") simply signals "many."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {八重桜|やえざくら}: double cherry blossom
- {八重|やえ}{咲|ざ}き: double-flowering (variety)
- {八重|やえ}{歯|ば}: snaggletooth (a tooth doubled over another)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一重|ひとえ}: single-petaled; single layer — the opposite; one layer of petals
